{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How long do educational licenses of QuickBooks last?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "The license won’t expire as long as an educator meets Intuit's eligibility requirements. QuickBooks Online for students is a 1-year trial."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How does my school sign up for QuickBooks?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "You will need to register with Intuit. Visit this page to complete the <a href=\"https://intuit.com/solutions/education/resources/quickbooks-support/educator-registration-form/\">registration form</a>."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How long does it take to receive the software?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "After completing registration, you can access QuickBooks Online Educator Portal within 20 minutes."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Why does the Education version of QuickBooks look different from my students’ version?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Product updates happen all the time and roll out slowly to all, so sometimes a student or educator may see something different. If you have concerns about discrepancies, please contact us at education@intuit.com."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How can I see my students work in QuickBooks Online?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "As an educator you will have access to QuickBooks Online Educator Portal which is where you can access your students files once they are set up."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What is the QuickBooks Educator Portal?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "The QuickBooks Educator portal allows you manage all of your students, classrooms, and assignments in one place. Teachers use the Educator Portal to manage student access to QuickBooks as well.\n\nYou can <a href=\"https://education-portal.app.intuit.com/app/dashboard\">access the portal here</a>. For a detailed overview, check out the <a href=\"https://vimeo.com/492154134/62a5c03f4e\">QuickBooks Educator Portal video</a>."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Not all of my students have access to their own computer. What are my options?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "With QuickBooks Online, students receive a cloud-based account that can be accessed on any computer or smartphone with an internet connection. Students who share devices with other students or family members can easily and securely access their QuickBooks Online account by logging in and out at their discretion."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How long does my free trial last?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "QuickBooks Online Plus is a 12-month trial."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Where do I get my license information?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "If you need access to QuickBooks Online, please reach out to your instructor as they will have to send you an invite."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "I did not receive the confirmation email with a license and product code. What should I do?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "If you didn't receive an email, check your Spam folder. You can search for an email from Intuit Verification Verify@SheerID.com. If you still are not able to find it, email us at education@intuit.com for help."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "My version of QuickBooks Online looks different today. How often does it update?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "To make sure you have the latest and greatest features, QuickBooks Online updates approximately every 6 weeks. You may experience slight changes to your software when new features are rolled out."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How can I see my students work in QuickBooks Online?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "To see your students QuickBooks, you will have to access to their company through the educator portal"
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "I'm starting a new class and already have a company in QuickBooks Online. How do I start over?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "As an educator, you can reset your demo company. As a student, your educator will need to invite you to a new QuickBooks company."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "My class ended, how do I add/remove students from my class?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "From your educator portal, you can remove the class under the \"class actions\" in the middle right hand side of your screen."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How do I set up payroll?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Set up QuickBooks Online Payroll without a subscription. Find details on setup <a href=\"https://quickbooks.intuit.com/learn-support/en-ca/help-article/payroll-setup/payroll-set-turn-payroll/L8u2BovFY_CA_en_CA\">here</a>."
      }
    }
  ]

Frequently asked questions General Expand all Collapse all How long do educational licenses of QuickBooks last? The license won’t expire as long as an educator meets Intuit's eligibility requirements. QuickBooks Online for students is a 1-year trial. How does my school sign up for QuickBooks? You will need to register with Intuit. Visit this page to complete the registration form . Educator Expand all Collapse all How long does it take to receive the software? After completing registration, you can access QuickBooks Online Educator Portal within 20 minutes. Why does the Education version of QuickBooks look different from my students’ version? Product updates happen all the time and roll out slowly to all, so sometimes a student or educator may see something different. If you have concerns about discrepancies, please contact us at education@intuit.com . How can I see my students work in QuickBooks Online? As an educator you will have access to QuickBooks Online Educator Portal which is where you can access your students files once they are set up. What is the QuickBooks Educator Portal? The QuickBooks Educator portal allows you manage all of your students, classrooms, and assignments in one place. Teachers use the Educator Portal to manage student access to QuickBooks as well. You can access the portal here . For a detailed overview, check out the QuickBooks Educator Portal video . Not all of my students have access to their own computer. What are my options? With QuickBooks Online, students receive a cloud-based account that can be accessed on any computer or smartphone with an internet connection. Students who share devices with other students or family members can easily and securely access their QuickBooks Online account by logging in and out at their discretion. Student Expand all Collapse all How long does my free trial last? QuickBooks Online Plus is a 12-month trial. Where do I get my license information? If you need access to QuickBooks Online, please reach out to your instructor as they will have to send you an invite. Technical Expand all Collapse all I did not receive the confirmation email with a license and product code. What should I do? If you didn't receive an email, check your Spam folder. You can search for an email from Intuit Verification Verify@SheerID.com . If you still are not able to find it, email us at education@intuit.com for help. My version of QuickBooks Online looks different today. How often does it update? To make sure you have the latest and greatest features, QuickBooks Online updates approximately every 6 weeks. You may experience slight changes to your software when new features are rolled out. How can I see my students work in QuickBooks Online? To see your students QuickBooks, you will have to access to their company through the educator portal. I'm starting a new class and already have a company in QuickBooks Online. How do I start over? As an educator, you can reset your demo company. As a student, your educator will need to invite you to a new QuickBooks company. My class ended, how do I add/remove students from my class? From your educator portal, you can remove the class under the "class actions" in the middle right hand side of your screen. How do I set up payroll? ​Set up QuickBooks Online Payroll without a subscription. Find details on setup here . mainEntity.name: How long do educational licenses of QuickBooks last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The license won’t expire as long as an educator meets Intuit's eligibility requirements. QuickBooks Online for students is a 1-year trial.

mainEntity.name: How does my school sign up for QuickBooks?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will need to register with Intuit. Visit this page to complete the registration form.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to receive the software?

acceptedAnswer.text: After completing registration, you can access QuickBooks Online Educator Portal within 20 minutes.

mainEntity.name: Why does the Education version of QuickBooks look different from my students’ version?

acceptedAnswer.text: Product updates happen all the time and roll out slowly to all, so sometimes a student or educator may see something different. If you have concerns about discrepancies, please contact us at education@intuit.com.

mainEntity.name: How can I see my students work in QuickBooks Online?

acceptedAnswer.text: As an educator you will have access to QuickBooks Online Educator Portal which is where you can access your students files once they are set up.

mainEntity.name: What is the QuickBooks Educator Portal?

acceptedAnswer.text: The QuickBooks Educator portal allows you manage all of your students, classrooms, and assignments in one place. Teachers use the Educator Portal to manage student access to QuickBooks as well. You can access the portal here. For a detailed overview, check out the QuickBooks Educator Portal video.

mainEntity.name: Not all of my students have access to their own computer. What are my options?

acceptedAnswer.text: With QuickBooks Online, students receive a cloud-based account that can be accessed on any computer or smartphone with an internet connection. Students who share devices with other students or family members can easily and securely access their QuickBooks Online account by logging in and out at their discretion.

mainEntity.name: How long does my free trial last?

acceptedAnswer.text: QuickBooks Online Plus is a 12-month trial.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get my license information?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you need access to QuickBooks Online, please reach out to your instructor as they will have to send you an invite.

mainEntity.name: I did not receive the confirmation email with a license and product code. What should I do?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you didn't receive an email, check your Spam folder. You can search for an email from Intuit Verification Verify@SheerID.com. If you still are not able to find it, email us at education@intuit.com for help.

mainEntity.name: My version of QuickBooks Online looks different today. How often does it update?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make sure you have the latest and greatest features, QuickBooks Online updates approximately every 6 weeks. You may experience slight changes to your software when new features are rolled out.

mainEntity.name: How can I see my students work in QuickBooks Online?

acceptedAnswer.text: To see your students QuickBooks, you will have to access to their company through the educator portal

mainEntity.name: I'm starting a new class and already have a company in QuickBooks Online. How do I start over?

acceptedAnswer.text: As an educator, you can reset your demo company. As a student, your educator will need to invite you to a new QuickBooks company.

mainEntity.name: My class ended, how do I add/remove students from my class?

acceptedAnswer.text: From your educator portal, you can remove the class under the "class actions" in the middle right hand side of your screen.

mainEntity.name: How do I set up payroll?

acceptedAnswer.text: Set up QuickBooks Online Payroll without a subscription. Find details on setup here.
